items.job: Replace hub bolts and wheels under recall

items.t: Defroster and heat stop working from A/C compressor fault (recall)
items.job: Update climate software and replace electric compressor if needed

items.t: Rearview camera freezes or goes blank (recall)
Loss of drive power from a battery control fault (recall)
12-volt battery goes dead, car won't start or unlock
items.job: Test charging system and replace 12-volt battery
items.note: A Subaru dealer lists about $175-$215 installed. Usually free under warranty.

items.t: Sudden power loss or EV system malfunction warning
items.job: Diagnose EV system fault and apply software updates
items.note: Diagnosis only: the fix depends on what the shop finds. RepairPal lists general/electrical diagnosis at $122–$179 for the Solterra. Usually covered by the warranty. High-voltage parts are covered by the 8-year EV warranty.

items.t: Wheel-well liners or underbody covers torn loose
items.job: Reinstall or replace wheel-well liners and underbody covers
items.note: Some owners were refused warranty coverage after driving through water.

items.t: Slow DC fast charging, especially in cold weather
items.job: Diagnose charging system and apply software updates
items.note: Diagnosis only: the fix depends on what the shop finds. RepairPal lists general/electrical diagnosis at $122–$179 for the Solterra. Usually covered by the warranty.

items.t: Real-world range far below the estimate
items.note: Diagnosis only: the fix depends on what the shop finds. RepairPal lists general/electrical diagnosis at $122–$179 for the Solterra. Usually covered by the warranty.

items.t: Car lurches or speeds up while parking
items.job: Diagnose drive and brake control system
items.note: Diagnosis only: the fix depends on what the shop finds. RepairPal lists general/electrical diagnosis at $122–$179 for the Solterra. Usually covered by the warranty.

items.t: Regenerative braking cuts in or out unexpectedly
items.job: Diagnose brake and regenerative braking control
items.note: Diagnosis only: the fix depends on what the shop finds. RepairPal lists general/electrical diagnosis at $122–$179 for the Solterra. Usually covered by the warranty.

items.t: Adaptive cruise doesn't detect cars ahead in rain
items.job: Diagnose and recalibrate front camera and radar
items.note: Diagnosis and calibration only. RepairPal lists general diagnosis at $122–$179; a glass shop quotes 30–60 minutes for Solterra driver-assist recalibration.

items.t: Driver monitor and lane assist false alerts
items.note: Diagnosis and calibration only. RepairPal lists general diagnosis at $122–$179; a glass shop quotes 30–60 minutes for Solterra driver-assist recalibration. Usually covered by the warranty.

items.t: Bluetooth or app features keep dropping
items.job: Diagnose infotainment and apply software update
items.note: Diagnosis only: often fixed with a software update. RepairPal lists body control system diagnosis at $49–$72 and electrical diagnosis at $122–$179 for the Solterra. Usually covered by the warranty.

items.t: Clicking from the front suspension over bumps
items.note: Diagnosis only: the fix depends on what the shop finds. RepairPal lists general/electrical diagnosis at $122–$179 for the Solterra. Usually covered by the warranty.

items.job: Replace windshield and recalibrate front camera
items.note: OEM Subaru windshield $567 sale to $856 list (listed for 2023–2024; confirm fit for 2025). Install takes about 60–90 minutes plus 30–60 minutes for camera recalibration. Should be a warranty claim on a newer car.

items.t: Headlights flicker or shake over bumps
items.job: Check headlight mounts and adjust headlight aim
items.note: Diagnosis and adjustment only; a loose or broken mount costs more. RepairPal lists headlamp alignment at $61–$90 for the Solterra.

items.t: Automatic braking or lane assist acts on its own
items.job: Wheel alignment and driver-assist camera/radar recalibration
items.note: One dealer blamed wheel alignment. RepairPal lists Solterra wheel alignment at $183–$269; recalibration adds about 30–60 minutes. Should be covered by the warranty on a 2026.
